To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The complete S42IL library is now genotyped with a high-density SNP array, which allows the identification of the introgressed regions in all lines; 2) A subset of 48 lines was evaluated for drought tolerance under terminal drought stress; 3) The introgression line S42IL121, which was previously identified to be drought tolerant under early drought stress, is also tolerant to terminal drought stress and shows a favorable QTL for thousand grain weight on chromosome
we (1) completed the S42IL map, (2) evaluated 49 S42 introgression lines for terminal drought tolerance and (3) detected 40 QTL in this experiment.
(i) we identified 40 QTL, including a QTL on chromosome 4, which increased TGW by 17% in a set of 49 S.42ILs under terminal drought stress.

the development of barley genotypes, which are adapted to the dry Mediterranean climate.
the genetic dissection of terminal drought tolerance in barley.
the identification of wild barley alleles, which are beneficial for barley breeding.

wild barley introgression line S42ILs represent an excellent resource for the identification of novel QTL and for the introgression of drought tolerance alleles in barley breeding.
wild barley introgression line S42ILs are a useful resource for the introgression of drought tolerance alleles into cultivated barley.

the wild barley introgression line S42IL121 is an interesting candidate for breeding drought tolerant barley cultivars, which can be used for both malting and feed barley.
the S42ILs can be successfully used in breeding programs to improve drought tolerance.
the wild barley introgression line S42IL121 is an excellent source for drought tolerance alleles and that the S42IL collection is a promising resource to identify QTLs for terminal drought tolerance.

wild barley introgression line S42IL121 is a promising donor of favorable QTL alleles for grain filling in terminal drought conditions and may be used in breeding programs to enhance drought tolerance in barley.
wild barley is a valuable source of drought tolerance genes and can be used for breeding barley cultivars with enhanced tolerance to drought stress.
wild barley introgression can be an efficient tool for improving the drought tolerance of barley.
